scope: fixed terminal-state counterfactuals; no stream publication
routing: From the current observation only: absent lexical text or token mismatch uses the alternative window; timing mismatch with an eligible local proposal uses shadow reconciliation; otherwise retain strict baseline. Never select by reference score.
notes: Two native windows per state; one past-only bootstrap window per new speaker. No separate warmup; alternate original/alternative order by case index and record first-call effects.
An alternative starts at the frozen committed boundary and cannot read evicted PCM. Its transcript is a counterfactual candidate, not permission to change an existing stream.
Held-out means unused by this project's development, not exclusion from Whisper training. Two speakers are a smoke check, not a generalization study.
Scores use human references only after action selection. Count local decision cost, alignment encoder work and padding, bootstrap and actual decoder calls.
No automatic retry. Stop further work after a lifecycle error. The resource configuration bounds one attempt, not provider rescheduling or the account invoice.
